title: Verify taskset line
description: One task of a Verify taskset. A taskset is JSON lines: one object per line, no enclosing array. Submitted as the taskset blob of VerifyRun, VerifyGenerate and (as the generators) VerifyGenerateAndCheck.

index.description: The task's index in the report. Defaults to the line's ordinal.

runtime.description: A runtime id from the controller's catalog: python-3.14.6, python-3.14.6-sympy-1.14.0, python-3.14.6-numpy-2.5.4 (numpy built in; its default integer is 32-bit, use dtype=np.int64 for 64-bit integers; no BLAS, threads or SIMD), quickjs-0.15.1, typescript-sucrase-3.35.1 (TypeScript, the types stripped by sucrase, no type check), ruby-3.4.1, lua-5.4.8 (the sources are files in a read-only folder that is the guest's whole file system: the entry is Lua's script, require finds a neighbour), clang-22.1.0 (C17 and C++20 without exceptions, compiled on the node under its own budget: .c, .cc, .cpp, .cxx sources are compiled and linked, headers sit beside them; the program runs as a raw WASI module), or wasi (the entry is itself a WASI command module, compiled from Rust, C/C++, Zig, TinyGo or anything else that targets wasm32-wasi). For lua and clang the source names use '/' and must be the same file on Windows, Linux and macOS. An unknown id yields RuntimeUnavailable for the task.

entry.description: The source file to run. Defaults to the first source. For the wasi runtime, the module file; its name is the guest's argv[0].

sources.description: File name → file content. For the python, quickjs, typescript and ruby runtimes the entry is the program, passed inline; for lua and clang every source is a file in a read-only folder; for the wasi runtime the entry is the module's bytes in base64 (a preflight rejects anything else).

args.description: Arguments after the entry (Python: sys.argv[1:]; wasi: argv[1:]).

stdin.description: Standard input for a run without a suite.

seed.description: Seed of the sandbox's deterministic random source (WASI random_get). Default 0.

suite.description: Test cases. The task passes when every case passes; the first failing case sets the verdict.

args.description: Appended to the task's args for this case.

expected_stdout.description: The exact stdout of a passing case; absent = only the exit code counts.

expected_exit.description: The exit code of a passing case. A non-zero exit where 0 was expected is a RuntimeError (the program crashed); any other mismatch is a Fail.

limits.description: Per-task limits; omitted fields take the job defaults, and every field is clamped to the host ceilings (fuel 2e12, memory 2 GiB, wall 120 s, stdout 8 MiB, stderr 1 MiB).

memory.description: Linear memory cap in bytes; default 256 MiB.

stdout_bytes.description: Captured stdout cap; default 256 KiB. Beyond it the task is OutputExceeded.
